capabilities: Adds presentation mode and slide navigation
Styles nodes and edges with shapes, borders, arrows and pathfinding
Integrates canvases with metadata cache, backlinks, outgoing links and frontmatter
Provides canvas commands, search, focus mode and collapsible groups
Exports canvases as PNG or SVG and annotates PDF pages
extras: All features can be toggled in settings; custom styles, breakpoints and colors are configured through CSS snippets.
intentEvidence: This plugin enhances the Obsidian canvas with a wide array of features
problem: Obsidian's canvas lacks presentation, advanced styling, metadata integration and PDF annotation.
summary: Canvas enhancement suite that adds presentation mode, node and edge styling, metadata support, PDF annotation, portals and image export.
